command: cargo test -p horizon-mods --features runtime,pack --test sandbox item_move -- --test-threads=1
measurement_limit: RSS sampled every 50 ms across cargo/test child processes; this is the test command tree, not a single game process or a before/after comparison.

resolved_fixture_failures.symptom: Old packaged hmods rejected at startup because their WIT event action enum had four variants while current runtime expected five.
resolved_fixture_failures.resolution: Rebuilt Modular Routers component and inserted it into an isolated copy of its carry hmod; rebuilt test guest packages and merged current guest WASM into a copy of reader assets.

resolved_fixture_failures.symptom: An unconditional one-slot peer fixture broke existing tests that require peer slot 0 to be out of bounds.
resolved_fixture_failures.resolution: Peer reads a declared one_slot config, false by default; game transfer fixture uses a separate manifest copy with true.

resolved_fixture_failures.symptom: The invalid-owner manifest test panicked during guest init before host block ownership validation.
resolved_fixture_failures.resolution: The test guest no longer asserts success for its valid capacity registration when run under a deliberately foreign owner namespace; the sandbox test now reaches and validates the intended host rejection.
